research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Unbridged namesakes, snippets, commercial people-finder pages, relatives, unsourced genealogy, postwar-only leads, and sources without an OSS, protected-identifier, rank, unit, or personnel-file bridge were rejected. Exact-name OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, newspaper, official-domain, and archival searches were checked as applicable. Exact-name CIA Reading Room checks produced no additional publishable employer source. Library of Congress collection discovery checks produced no reliable identity bridge. The NARA index page was text-extracted, rendered, and visually checked; official Army bulk data, technical documentation, and code documentation were inspected locally. No search-result snippet was used as sole final evidence, no paywall or access control was bypassed, and no authenticated NARA Catalog API call was made.
